Class LightShipBoard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.lightmodel.LightShipBoard
All Implemented Interfaces:
ShipBoardInterface, Remote
public class LightShipBoard extends Object implements ShipBoardInterface, Remote
This class represents the light version of the shipboard in the game. It simplifies the shipboard data, allowing easier communication between client and server. The `LightShipBoard` class includes methods for initializing the ship, positioning tiles, managing cargo, and tracking crew, shields, and other game-related elements.

It is used in conjunction with the `ShipBoard` class to manage the game state on the client side.

    • epidemic

      public ArrayList<Tile> epidemic()
      Simulates an epidemic affecting the crew members aboard the ship. The epidemic spreads based on adjacency between crew cabins that are connected by non-smooth links (e.g., walls). If two crew cabins are adjacent without a smooth connection, the crew in the second cabin is infected.
      Specified by:
      epidemic in interface ShipBoardInterface

      a list of the modified tiles (i.e., the infected crew cabins) after the epidemic spreads

    • setGetStat

      public void setGetStat()
      Resets the ship's status and updates the status of each tile on the ship. This method is responsible for ensuring that the ship's statistics are reset before updating the status of each tile. It checks every tile on the ship's grid, and if the tile is fillable, it updates the tile's status.

    • setCabinStat

      public void setCabinStat()
      Updates the status of each cabin on the ship. This method specifically updates the status of the crew cabins. It iterates through all the cabin coordinates and updates the status of the tiles at those positions.
